text.default: Hello! Would you like to see our menu, or do you know what you want?
Here is our menu: {menu}. What would you like? Please name one item and a quantity from one to three.
{item} costs ${price} each. Would you like to order it?
You would like {order}. Your total is ${total}. Would you like to confirm and pay?
Thank you! You paid ${total}. Here is your {order}. Enjoy! Would you like anything else?
Your order is cancelled. You have not been charged for it. What would you like instead?
Your order costs ${total}, but you don't have enough money. You have not been charged. Would you like to change or cancel it?
That item or its price has changed. You have not been charged, and I have cleared your order. Please ask for the menu and order again.
You don't have a pending order. What would you like to order?
Which item from our menu would you like? For coffee, please choose a specific drink, such as espresso or cappuccino. Your existing order stays unchanged.
Please order between one and three of an item. Your existing order stays unchanged. How many would you like?
Please order one type of item at a time. Your existing order stays unchanged. Which item would you like first?
Would you like to see the menu, ask a price, order an item, change your order or cancel? Your existing order stays unchanged.
Goodbye! Any unpaid order is cancelled. Have a lovely day!
Please ask the receptionist at the station information desk for a bus ticket to Town Street. Have you spoken to the receptionist yet?
